job.title: Seeking NLP expert: hotel review sentiment and topic dashboard

args.cover_letter:
Found a housekeeping issue at one property; its rating recovered 0.4 stars in a quarter: that was the outcome of my hotel review sentiment and topic dashboard project, which is close to what you describe.

For HuggingFace Transformers: in the invoice field extraction pipeline project I fine-tuned LayoutLMv3 on 1,200 labelled invoices and served it behind a FastAPI endpoint in Docker.

Since you need a design that scales, my plan is a short discovery call, a first working milestone you can test, then documentation and a handover call.

Is the NLP part already started, or would this be built from scratch?
answers: I would rather discuss this on a short call.
Access to the current code or data, one sample of the expected output, and a 30-minute kickoff to agree the first milestone.
